title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game Posts Story Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a second story trailer for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise, on Thursday. A demo version of the game will be available on June 16.
author: ANN

title: Kill Blue Anime Casts Ikumi Hasegawa
content: The staff for the television anime of Tadatoshi Fujimaki 's Kill Blue manga announced on Saturday that kumi Hasegawa is joining the cast as Mai Otohime, a marine sports prodigy (known as the "Mermaid Queen") with both a shy, petite "Chibi-hime" side and a bold "Gyaru-hime" side.
author: ANN

title: 4 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime Creator’s Most Underrated Series Gets a New Release
content: The anime adaptation of Takopi’s Original Sin shocked the anime industry with its dark and complex themes. Written and illustrated by Taizan 5, the short manga series was serialized in Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ platform in 2021. The anime adaptation is last year’s darkest and one of the most highly rated anime series.

content: The anime and manga industry is growing ever so rapidly, which also means that the older series eventually get forgotten over time. However, there are always exceptions to the rule, especially if the story is well-received by fans.

title: Crunchyroll May Be Losing The Most Anticipated Shonen Jump Anime
content: Crunchyroll is the largest streaming service for anime fans across the globe. Launched in 2017, the platform didn’t take long to rise through the ranks and eventually add a plethora of anime series and films that can’t be found elsewhere.

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Unveils New Look At The Best Characters For Upcoming Release
content: Exactly one year after the Japanese premiere of Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle , the series is all set for its home video release. Following the Hashira Training in 2024, the anime confirmed a trilogy film adaptation for the manga’s longest and most intense arc.
